children: Evolution Metals joined the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 indexes, becoming eligible for funds tracking about $12.2 trillion in benchmarked assets.
FTSE Russell added Evolution Metals to Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 effective at market open Sept 21, 2026.
Membership makes Evolution Metals immediately eligible for index-tracking products and institutional mandates.
Company cites ramp to ~10,000 MT annual magnet capacity and secured non-China NdPr feedstock supporting growth.
EM&T highlights 13 ULVAC machines arriving Nov 2026 and a 750 MW KEPCO electrical agreement for Pohang expansion.
Press release notes initial fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $400M–$460M and potential benefits from index inclusion.
